summary: Budget pacer hold of 2026-11-18: override for the window with a ceiling of one executor

options.description: Override the pacer for the window with a ceiling of one executor
Leave the hold; executors stay at 0 until usage is back under the line
Override the pacer for the window with no ceiling below executors.max

body: Problem: the budget pacer held executors at 0 (weekly usage 21 percent against a 15.4 percent line) with 10 tasks queued, so nothing landed. Ruling: override the pacer for the current window with a runtime ceiling of one executor (scale --max 1, then resume --budget). Applied 2026-11-18 about 23:30Z; the override ends at the usage reset of 2026-11-24T19:00Z. It covers this window only. The options are those put to the operator through the decision rubric on 2026-11-18; recorded by the planner.
